metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-55040: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.. Product: SharePoint
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-55040" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-55040" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-55040" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-GENERAL-008
